about.blurb: Local-only encrypted sticky notes for Windows. MIT licensed.
about.hello: Hi I'm Ahmi, hope this helps!
about.title: About
autoLock.blurb: Lock the vault after inactivity. Idle is checked every few seconds, so locking can lag slightly behind the timer.
autoLock.footnote: Off keeps notes open until you lock or quit. Existing stickies are never touched by this setting.
autoLock.title: Auto-lock
delete.body: {title} will be removed permanently from the vault.
delete.title: Delete note?
error.alreadyExists: A vault already exists on this PC.
error.atomicReplace: Could not save the vault safely. Saved stickies were left untouched. {detail}
error.bodyOnly: The note text is only available in its own sticky window.
error.crypto: Could not encrypt or decrypt the vault. {detail}
error.io: Could not read or write a file. {detail}
error.managerOnly: Only the manager window can do that.
error.noDataDir: SecretSticky could not find the folder where notes are saved.
error.noRecovery: No recovery key is set up for this vault.
error.noteAcl: This note window cannot open a different note.
error.noteNotFound: That note could not be found.
error.notInitialized: The vault is not set up yet.
error.passwordShort: Password must be at least 12 characters.
error.serialize: Could not read the vault file. {detail}
error.tooMany: Too many failed attempts. Retry in {seconds}s.
error.unauthorized: This window is not allowed to do that.
error.vaultVersionNewer: Vault format version {version} is newer than this app supports ({supported}). Upgrade SecretSticky. Saved stickies were not changed.
error.windowIcon: Could not set the window icon. {detail}
language.blurb: SecretSticky follows your Windows language the first time it opens. Pick a language to switch right away. Your notes, password, and auto-lock stay as they are.
language.title: Language
note.closeHint: Close this window and open the note again from the manager.
note.copyTitle: Copy selection or full body (auto-clears in 30s)
notes.empty: No notes yet — pick a color to create one.
notes.hideTitle: Hide manager; app stays in the tray
password.blurb: Re-wraps the vault key. Your recovery key stays valid.
password.errShort: New password must be at least 12 characters.
password.title: Change master password
password.updated: Password updated. Recovery key is unchanged.
recovery.body: This is shown once. Store it offline. Losing both your master password and this key means your notes cannot be recovered.
recovery.fineprint: Protects data at rest on disk. Does not protect a fully compromised PC while unlocked.
recovery.title: Save your recovery key
unlock.blurbSetup: Choose a strong master password. Notes are encrypted on disk.
unlock.blurbUnlock: Enter your master password to open encrypted sticky notes.
unlock.fineprint: Local only · Argon2id + XChaCha20-Poly1305 · no cloud
unlock.hideTrayTitle: Hide to tray — open again from the tray icon
font.blurb: Choose the typeface for every window. Your notes stay as they are.
